''See also: [[Benri Vallenar Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Benri Vallenar is the president of the [[Vallenar Corporation]] and the father of [[Varic Vallenar]], the captain of the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]] known as [[The Last Horizon]]. A man of significant influence and reputation, he carries himself with an air of ownership and [[Authority|authority]], often appearing in tailored suits or luxury silk clothing. Physically, he is described as having dark skin with wrinkles and silver hair and eyes, though his features have faded slightly with age. He possesses unique magical abilities that allow him to gain deep insight into the true nature of people through the [[Aether]], and he utilizes a magical tool known as the [[Mirror of Silence]]. Throughout his career, Benri has navigated complex political and economic landscapes, often driven by a desire for profit and the ambition to be a primary decision-maker in galactic affairs. His life has been marked by high-stakes interactions, including being kidnapped by the [[Iron King]] and forced into magical contracts with the [[Iron Legion]]. While he maintains a professional persona, his relationship with his son is complicated, and he has occasionally been used as leverage or bait in various galactic conflicts. Despite his immense wealth and corporate power, he has expressed feelings of being a mere hireling rather than a true leader of the universe.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Benri Vallenar is a man with dark skin, an impressive barrel chest, and short-slashed silver hair. He possesses a goatee and cold, [[steel]]-colored silver eyes, and he also has an [[optical implant]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As the President of the [[Vallenar Corporation]], Benri considers his life to be an extension of his work. He finds it difficult to extend trust to unknown entities and has experienced feelings of smugness regarding a victory, though he felt unsatisfied by his inability to take credit for it.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Benri Vallenar is the father of [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] and the narrator. He also received a recording involving an individual named [[Nila]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An [[Archmage]] with unique magic, Benri is a [[wizard]] who utilizes a staff and a [[Mirror of Silence]]. He can generate colorless copies of himself that are capable of leaving his body due to [[Aethertech]] enhancements, and he is also able to copy shield generators and guns.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Vallenar Crew Member}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Benri Vallenar is a member of the [[Vallenar crew]] who possesses an [[optical implant]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c18">''The Pilot'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c22">''The Pilot'', chapter 22</ref> A President and father to the galaxy's greatest mortal spellcaster, Benri works by hooking up a [[data core]] to a computer for analysis.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c22" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref> While informing the Captain that negotiations are underway, Benri manages possibilities through the use of a [[console]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> He believed that the lid and the [[Voice of Solstice]] were communicating, and although he felt smug about a recent victory, he remained unsatisfied by his inability to take credit for it.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38">''The Pilot'', chapter 38</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39">''The Pilot'', chapter 39</ref> As an [[Archmage]] and a clone, Benri is the original version of himself and serves as the president of a galactic corporation.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" /> This Vallenar man has survived a one-on-one conversation with the [[Iron King]], has spent time in long-term stasis, and has a son.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" /> Due to [[Aethertech]] enhancements, his clones are capable of leaving a body.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Your…son? Is he working with the company again?”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“How may I assist you, Mister Vallenar?”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c38" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|“Are we going to talk this time,” my father asked, “or are you going to have half a conversation and then hang up on me?”<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“It’s hard to extend trust when I don’t know who I’m dealing with,” Benri said.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“President Vallenar!” she said pleasantly.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c11" />}}
